items: 【Save Time And Effort】 Upgraded Electric Spin Scrubber Cordless gets rid of the troubles caused by traditional cleaning tools. it can be used anywhere you want. This spin scrubber is super lightweight and very easy to pick up and use to clean surfaces without getting tired and drastically reduce your work time from 1 hour to 30 minutes.

【Powerful & Efficiency】The internal motor drives the rotating brush head to rotate at a high speed up to 450RPM±10%, can help you easily clean your entire house,especially when used with a cleaning agent, it can quickly clean stubborn stains and make entire house look new! Perfect for bathroom,bath tub,stone tile floor,grout,grooves,Toilet & etc.

【2 Adjustable Speed & IPX7 Waterproof 】You can easily clean your entire house in one fell swoop with this cleaning brush ,it set has 2 working speeds, I: Low Speed: 350RPM/Min; II:High Speed: 450RPM/Min; What you need to do is press the ON/OFF button once. The entire machine is IPX7 waterproof,you can wash the electric scrubber directly into the faucet without worrying about product damage.

【4 Replaceable Brush Heads】TUYU electric spin scrubber has equipped with 4 cleaning heads, a hard flat brush for large surfaces, a corner brush for curved areas, a small flat brush for detail work, and a pointed brush for gaps. All the brushes have long bristles that resist shedding and won’t scratch surfaces. which can be suitable for bathroom, kitchen, table, bathtub, floor,windows and Car various scenarios to meet most of your requirements.

【Adjustable extension Rod】The electric shower scrubber equipped with extendable stainless-steel handle . The handle can freely extends from 26 inches to 45 inches easy to clean hard-to-reach places, without kneeling or bending over. Say Goodbye to Traditional Cleaning Tools.A new type of household cleaning tools that can change your life!

【LED Display & Fast Charging 】Equipped with an LED digital display of battery usage,you will never need to worry about running out of power. The electric spin scrubber used fast charging technology, equipped with Type C charging port ,you can recharge it easier.Indicator light will be red when it's charging and get green when it's full.

【Perfect Gift For Family And Friends】Portable cordless hand-held shower scrubber is ergonomically designed, you can use the electric cleaning brush to do housework in the most relaxed posture, no need to bend down and kneel to clean, take care of your waist and joints, save time and effort. it is an ideal gift for family, parents and friends, make housework a fun.
